F-Droid Archville

Apps from the official F-Droid Archive that no longer install or run on current Android, rebuilt from their original source for modern phones. Source and build changes: https://github.com/PrinceGarth/archville

Currently it serves 2 apps. To add it to your F-Droid app, scan the QR code (click it to enlarge) or use this link:

https://princegarth.github.io/archville/repo
